reviews.review_text: The best thing I liked about the online MBA course at NMIMS was the extended course duration. Due to some issues, I dropped out for a year, but later on managed to complete my program within a span of 3 years.
For me NMIMS online MBA was up to the mark and met all my expectations. However, there is a little scope for improvement, but overall, I had a good experience.
I recently graduated from the NMIMS online MBA program, and it is a worthwhile option due to its minimal interaction with faculty and self paced learning facility.
The online MBA course at Narsee Monjee also offers career services that I liked the most, and on behalf of it, I recommend it to others too.

faqs.question: What are the key features of the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management program?
faqs.answer: Competence in relevant skills, access to cutting-edge ed-tech, flexibility, and industry knowledge with efficiency are the key features of the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management program.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management require graduation with at least 50% aggregate marks.

faqs.question: How is the curriculum structured for the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management?
faqs.answer: The curriculum is structured in a semester pattern for the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management, with the core courses in the initial year and specialization-oriented electives in the term-end semesters.

faqs.question: Will the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management help me transition into a career in data science?
faqs.answer: Yes, the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management's personalized career services and placement assistance help you transition into a career in data science with a competitive package.

faqs.question: How does the NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management program support job placement or internships?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS Online MBA in Operations & Data Science Management program supports job placement and internships via its career services. It includes career growth modules with interview opportunities, mentorship from industry stalwarts, and guidance for enhancing your employability.

data.eligibility_content:
The eligibility criteria for the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

The interested candidate must have completed a bachelor's degree with a 10+2+3 educational qualification from a recognized university.

The applicant must have scored a minimum of 50% aggregate marks at the graduation level (45% for reserved category students, SC/ST/OBC/PwD).
data.admission_steps:
To enroll in the NMIMS online MBA course, follow the below listed step-by-step admission process for a hassle-free enrollment procedure:

Step 1. Visit the official website of NMIMS Online and register.

Step 2. Complete the registration process to receive credentials to access the admission portal.

Step 3. Start filling out the application form with accurate information.

Step 4. Attach the supporting documents and submit the NMIMS online MBA application form.

Step 5. The university will verify the application form, documents, and fee.

Step 6. Once the verification is completed, the university will issue a "student number" and dispatch your study kit along with the activation of the student portal and LMS.

data.about_content:
The NMIMS online MBA in Operations and Data Science Management is offered to make students and working professionals capable of adapting and thriving in a dynamic business environment. This course is ideal for candidates who are eager to become competent operations managers with expertise in the fundamentals of business management with the principles of operations management.

Working professionals can easily maintain a good work-life balance while pursuing the NMIMS online MBA in operations and data science management course with its flexibility and online learning environment. The course is developed to offer relevant production and operations management skills required for performance management, production optimization, and cost-cutting for determining the output.

The NMIMS online MBA in operations and data science management offers access to world-class study resources via live lectures, e-books, case studies, whitepapers, and journals through the digital library. The course ensures that it meets the global academic requirements and standards to provide international exposure to enrolled students.

data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

data.syllabus_content:
With the emerging requirements of digital learning, the NMIMS online MBA in operations and data science management syllabus follows a 100% virtual course delivery methodology and follows a semester plan that consists of core and elective subjects as per the chosen specialization by the student. The detailed course syllabus can be viewed below for your reference.

Year I

Semester I

  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Micro Economics & Macro Economics
  • Organisational Behaviour
  • Marketing Management
  • Quantitative Methods – I

Semester II

  • Cost & Management Accounting
  • Human Resource Management
  • Strategic Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Legal Aspect of Business
  • Operations Management

Year II

Semester III

  • Corporate Finance
  • Project Management
  • Project Pre-work
  • Research Methodology
  • Strategic Applications of IoT and Big Data
  • Strategic sourcing and E-procurement
  • Supply Chain Management

Semester IV

  • Corporate Sustainability
  • EDA and Data Visualization
  • Indian Ethos & Ethics
  • International Business
  • Operations Analytics
  • Project
  • Total Quality Management
